description: Environment setup and baseline verification. Confirm the project installs and builds green before any changes, so later features start from a known-good state.
steps: Source Node from nvm: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" (node is not on PATH otherwise; expect Node v22, npm 11).
Run `npm run build` and confirm it exits 0 with no TypeScript errors (the postbuild next-sitemap step running is normal).

Confirm the CoinGecko free endpoint is reachable: curl 'https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum&vs_currencies=usd&include_24hr_change=true' returns JSON with usd and usd_24h_change fields.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` completes with exit code 0 and no type errors.
CoinGecko endpoint returns valid JSON with price and 24h change fields.
verification: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; cd /projects/sandbox/Coinscribed.com; npm run build
findings: Baseline is green. Node v22.23.2, npm 11.4.2 (sourced from nvm; node not on PATH by default as documented). `npm install` reported 'up to date' (deps already present) and completed without errors; note 5 high-severity npm audit vulnerabilities exist but do not block the build. `npm run build` exits 0 with no TypeScript errors; postbuild next-sitemap ran normally and generated https://coinscribed.com/sitemap.xml. All routes prerendered as expected (homepage / is Static ○). CoinGecko free endpoint verified reachable: curl returned valid JSON e.g. {"bitcoin":{"usd":77979,"usd_24h_change":-0.2486...},"ethereum":{"usd":2437.39,"usd_24h_change":-0.7906...}} with both usd and usd_24h_change fields present. No source code changes in this feature. Working tree before this task had only the untracked .agents/ task-state directory. Confirms the client-side-fetch requirement for the ticker is viable in later features.
